top_signals.title: Stocks Fall Amid Tech Earnings; Oil Climbs as MidEast Tensions Rise
top_signals.summary: US equity futures slide as a recovery rally in AI fades. Meta boosts its capital spending plans for the year. Oil rises as the US pulls some diplomats from Saudi Arabia amid worsening tensions between Houthis and Iran. George Goncalves of MUFG joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss opportunities in bonds amid market volatility.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Corn Extends Gains on Dip-Buying, Signs of Stronger EU Demand
top_signals.summary: US corn futures rose for a second day as buyers came into the market after a decline, while demand in Europe showed signs of improvement.

top_signals.title: Grid Constraints Curtailed 119 GW of Renewables in India in September
top_signals.summary: Grid, flexibility, and transmission constraints amid limited battery storage forced India to curtail as much as 118.6 gigawatts (GW) of solar and wind power capacity in September, data by India’s JMK Research & Analytics showed.   A total of 118.6 GW of renewable energy capacity was affected by curtailment last month, including 96.9 GW of solar and 21.7 GW of wind capacity, according to data from regulator Grid-India.  “Key reasons for RE curtailment include demand-generation mismatches, transmission constraints,…

top_signals.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
top_signals.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
